title: Durin's Bane
description: Durin III breaks through into the mithril — and the Balrog. Free of the ring at last, he names his son king and leaps at the demon with his axe as the cavern comes down.

title: The Dark Wizard's offer
description: The Dark Wizard greets the Stranger as an old friend: five of them were sent, he says, and together the two of them could rule in place of Sauron. Refused, he brings the canyon down on the Stoors.

title: Farewell to Nori
description: The Stoors must find a new home, and Nori and Poppy will go with them. In the rubble the Stranger finds the staff that was meant for him.

title: The Faithful are hunted
description: In the palantír Pharazôn sees Sauron's face, and brands the Faithful as his servants. Eärien warns her father in time; Míriel stays to face the king and sends Elendil west with a sword — Narsil, the White Flame.

title: Elendil rides west
description: Elendil escapes toward Andúnië, the stronghold of the Faithful in the west of the island.

title: Pelargir is claimed for the king
description: Kemen lands at Pelargir and declares it a fortress of Númenor: its people will cut timber for the crown. He orders Isildur home and will not have a 'low' woman aboard, so Isildur sails without Estrid.

title: The death of Celebrimbor
description: Sauron tortures Celebrimbor for the Nine. The smith dies naming him what he will become — Lord of the Rings — and Sauron weeps as he kills him.

title: The Orcs choose a new master
description: Nenya has healed Adar into the Elf he once was. He gives the ring back to Galadriel and offers peace — and his own children, turned by Sauron, cut him down as they once cut down their first master.

title: Sauron and Galadriel
description: On a cliff above the burning city the two duel. Sauron wounds her with Morgoth's crown and takes the Nine; Galadriel keeps Nenya and throws herself from the edge.

title: The Dwarves arrive
description: King Durin IV's warriors reach Eregion at last and cover the retreat of the surviving Elves.

title: A hidden valley
description: The survivors shelter in a valley north of Eregion. Elrond and Gil-galad heal Galadriel with their rings, and she chooses to stand and fight. The sanctuary will one day be called Imladris.

title: A name at last
description: Back at Tom's fireside, staff in hand, the Stranger thinks over what the Stoors kept calling him — Grand-Elf. He has a name now: Gandalf.

title: A crown and seven rings
description: Durin and Disa mourn the old king. Other Dwarf-lords are already asking after the rings he promised them, and the throne is not yet secure.
